info.name: Cool Engineering Games
info.description:
Phase 2 tests. Every request goes through the gateway (gatewayUrl). Run the whole collection top to bottom with the Collection Runner: later requests reuse tokens and ids saved by earlier ones, and the Cleanup folder deletes everything the run created, so it can be repeated.

Set adminPassword in the environment to the BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD from docker/.env. The password-reminder folder reads the reset email from Mailpit (mailUrl).

exec: // one unique suffix per run keeps usernames and emails from colliding between runs
pm.test('is a PLAYER and ACTIVE', () => { pm.expect(u.role).to.eql('PLAYER'); pm.expect(u.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); });

item.name: Register - the role cannot be chosen

exec: pm.test('same answer as a wrong password, so usernames cannot be probed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('wrongPasswordBody')));
pm.test('returns a bearer token', () => { pm.expect(r.tokenType).to.eql('Bearer'); pm.expect(r.accessToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(r.expiresIn).to.eql(3600); });
pm.test('the token names the user and role', () => { pm.expect(claims.sub).to.eql(String(pm.collectionVariables.get('playerId'))); pm.expect(claims.roles).to.eql(['PLAYER']); });
pm.test('200 (login with an email address works too)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: Player cannot read another user's account (403)
Administrator verifies the player as a developer
The old token still says PLAYER (403)

exec: pm.test('403 (roles live in the token until the next login)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

item.name: Log in again to get the developer role

exec: pm.test('the creator is the token user', () => pm.expect(g.creatorId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('playerId'))));

item.name: A creator cannot choose the creator or status

exec: pm.test('creator and status come from the platform', () => { pm.expect(g.creatorId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('playerId'))); pm.expect(g.approvalStatus).to.eql('PENDING'); });

item.name: A pending game is hidden from other players (404)
The public list leaves out pending games
The creator lists their own games in any state

exec: pm.test('both pending games are listed', () => { const ids = pm.response.json().map(g => g.id); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('gameId'))); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('pendingGameId'))); });

item.name: The creator cannot approve their own game (403)
Players now see the approved game
Another player cannot edit someone else's game (403)
Editing an approved game sends it back for review
4. Bearer token across services (engagement calls the catalog)
A player reacts to an approved game
The user in the body is ignored

exec: pm.test('stored for the token user, not for 999999', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().userId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('playerId'))));

item.name: Same endpoint, same pending game: a player gets 404

exec: pm.test('404 (engagement forwarded the token, the catalog hides the game from this user)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

item.name: Same endpoint, same pending game: an administrator gets 201

exec: pm.test('201 (the catalog saw the administrator token and let the call through)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

item.name: A game cannot be reacted to twice (409)
Nobody can change someone else's reaction (403)
Add the game to my library
A library is private: another user's is empty of it
Nobody can edit someone else's comment (403)

exec: pm.test('the answer is identical, so addresses cannot be probed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('unknownResetBody')));

item.name: Read the reset email from Mailpit

exec: // the email is sent in the background: give it a moment to arrive
pm.test('contains a reset link with a token', () => pm.expect(m).to.not.be.null);

item.name: Reset the password with the emailed token
The old password no longer works (401)
6. Account status and admin guard rails
A suspended user cannot log in (403)
The user can log in again
The last administrator cannot be deleted (409)
The last administrator cannot be demoted (409)
Service discovery: every service is registered in Eureka

exec: pm.test('gateway, identity, catalog and engagement are all registered', () => pm.expect(apps).to.include.members(['GATEWAY', 'IDENTITY-SERVICE', 'GAME-CATALOG-SERVICE', 'ENGAGEMENT-SERVICE']));
pm.test('every instance is UP', () => pm.response.json().applications.application.forEach(a => a.instance.forEach(i => pm.expect(i.status).to.eql('UP'))));

item.name: Gateway routes are visible to administrators only (403 for players)

exec: pm.test('every route resolves through Eureka (lb://)', () => pm.expect(uris.every(u => u.startsWith('lb://'))).to.be.true);

item.name: Config server serves the prod profile
Remove the game from the library
A user deletes their own account
Administrator deletes the remaining test account
A deleted account cannot log in (401)
